items.text: ETR Sunday AM summary: NOT EXPECTED - McConkey, Caleb Williams, Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Slayton, Palmer. GTD - Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. EXPECTED - Flowers, Carnell Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan Allen. Messiest injury week; no Bengals WR info yet.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports; aligns with Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: Critical for early slate decisions; projections updated.
items.opportunity: Monitor remaining GTDs and Bengals silence.

items.text: Vikings WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both questionable; will work out pregame. Jefferson determined for Louisiana homecoming.
items.implication: High uncertainty; check inactives ~90 min prior.
items.opportunity: If both limited/out, other MIN targets rise.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot), listed questionable and no practice this week, is not expected to play vs Broncos.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; look to other LAC pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Quentin Johnston and remaining WRs.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe), questionable, unlikely to play vs Colts; final determination in pregame warmups.
items.implication: Elevate Jaylen Warren as primary back.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis/ankle) hopeful to play but not definite; will work out pregame. LV elevated a RB in case. ETR lists as GTD.
items.implication: Monitor pregame closely; have handcuff ready.
items.opportunity: If out, backup RB elevated gets work.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs DET as details finalized. Rapoport and ETR confirm inactive/soon-to-be-traded.
items.why: Trade being finalized; team informed player morning of game.
items.implication: Removes MHJ from lineups; boosts remaining ARI WRs especially in DET matchup.
items.opportunity: Full target share available for Michael Wilson and others.

items.text: Chargers starting four rookies on OL (LT Logan Taylor, LG Jake Slaughter, C Jacob Spomer, RT Alex Harkey) with Slater and Alt out vs DEN. Herbert has six straight games without more TDs than INTs.
items.implication: Herbert and LAC pass catchers face pressure risk; McConkey already out.

items.text: Doctors around NFL believe it's when-not-if Jayden Daniels reinjures left elbow. Rapoport notes Daniels making return; Lamar has real chance next week.
items.why: Medical consensus on elbow fragility; return confirmed by Rap.
items.implication: Start with caution; monitor for reinjury. Lamar next-week upside.
items.opportunity: Daniels full snaps if healthy enough; Lamar rehab progressing.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Falcons on SNF.
items.why: Schefter report; Rapoport notes Humphrey also expected.
items.implication: Start Flowers with confidence in BAL offense.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play.

MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor; inactive/trade elevates Kia Kendrick Bourne and Michael Wilson for the season. Quotes ETR summary noting messiest injury week and Bengals WR void.
items.why: Low prior production from MHJ; clear path for Wilson/Bourne.
items.implication: Wilson becomes must-start/priority add in ARI offense vs DET.
items.opportunity: Wilson target/route share expansion post-MHJ exit.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10; volume/RZ boost especially with MHJ inactive.
Hates Jordan Addison @ NO as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle.
items.implication: Sit if possible; GTD compounds risk.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red zone vs Titans defense that struggles vs WRs.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; gobbles targets/fantasy points, usage boost possible with Bengals WR injuries.
Hates Cam Skattebo @ WSH as RB20; efficiency and game environment concerns despite Rapoport noting expect a lot of volume.
Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX (London) as QB15; rough stretch and banged-up line.
